  SDK: google-cloud-documentai
  Interface: sdk

  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/ocr

  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: begin_analyze_document
  Setup hints: AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_ENDPOINT, AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_KEY
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/ai-services/document-intelligence/prebuilt/invoice

Option 5 — Mindee:

  SDK: mindee
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: parse, invoice
  Setup hints: MINDEE_API_KEY
  Official docs: https://developers.mindee.com/docs/python-sdk

output_text:
```python
from google.cloud import documentai_v1 as documentai
from google.protobuf.json_format import MessageToDict

def validate_extracted_fields(document, required_fields):
    """
    Validates that the required structured fields are present and have confidence scores above the minimum threshold.

    Args:
        document (Document): The Document AI document object.
        required_fields (list): A list of field names that are required to be present in the document.

    Returns:
        bool: True if all required fields are present with confidence scores >= 0.8, False otherwise.
    """
    def extract_field_values(document):
        """
        Extracts field values and their confidence scores from the Document AI document.

        Args:
            document (Document): The Document AI document object.

        Returns:
            dict: A dictionary where keys are field names and values are tuples of (field_value, confidence).
        """
        field_values = {}
        for page_data in document.pages:
            for block in page_data.blocks:
                block_text = block.layout.text_anchor.content
                block_confidence = block.layout.confidence
                for style in block.layout.styles:
                    if isinstance(style, documentai.Styling.Style):
                        field_name = style.key
                        field_values[field_name] = (block_text, block_confidence)
        return field_values

    field_values = extract_field_values(document)
    for field in required_fields:
        if field not in field_values or field_values[field][1] < 0.8:
            return False
    return True

def process_document_ai_invoice(document_path, required_fields):
    """
    Processes an invoice document with Google Cloud Document AI and validates the required fields.

    Args:
        document_path (str): The path to the invoice document.
        required_fields (list): A list of field names that are required to be present in the document.

    Returns:
        dict: The extracted fields and their values if validation passes, None otherwise.
    """
    client = documentai.DocumentProcessorServiceClient()
    name = "projects/your-project-id/locations/us/processors/your-processor-id"
    with open(document_path, 'rb') as image:
        image_content = image.read()
    document = documentai.Document(content=image_content, mime_type='application/pdf')
    response = client.process_document(name=name, inline_document=document)
    extracted_document = response.document
    if validate_extracted_fields(extracted_document, required_fields):
        parsed_response = MessageToDict(extracted_document)
        return parsed_response
    else:
        return None
```
